title: The Ferry Schedule Shuffle
story: Jonah's ferry leaves every half hour on September mornings, never a minute late. Last Tuesday, four regulars each rode a different morning run to a different stop, and Pilot greeted each of them in his little orange life vest. Now two of the four say they saw a light blink out at Thimble Point on the way, though the old lamp is supposed to be dark. Jonah wants his passenger log straight. Who rode when, and where?

texts: Of the passenger bound for Pine Key and the passenger bound for the mainland, one took the 7:00 a.m. ferry and the other took the 8:00 a.m. ferry.
Of the passenger on the 7:00 a.m. ferry and the passenger on the 8:30 a.m. ferry, one is Amara and the other is Tova.
Tova rode to neither Gull Island nor the mainland.
Ruben sailed half an hour before the passenger bound for Gull Island.

trace.text: Clue 4 means Gull Island cannot be the 7:00 a.m. ferry and Ruben cannot be the 8:30 a.m. ferry.
Clue 1 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).

Since Gull Island can still be only the 7:30 a.m. ferry or the 8:30 a.m. ferry and Ruben can still be only the 7:00 a.m. ferry, the 7:30 a.m. ferry, or the 8:00 a.m. ferry, clue 4 means Ruben cannot be the 7:30 a.m. ferry.
Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Ruben must go with the 8:00 a.m. ferry: clue 2 rules out the 7:00 a.m. ferry; clue 4 rules out the 7:30 a.m. ferry and the 8:30 a.m. ferry.
Priya must go with the 7:30 a.m. ferry: clue 2 rules out the 7:00 a.m. ferry and the 8:30 a.m. ferry; the 8:00 a.m. ferry already goes with Ruben.
Since Gull Island can still be only the 7:30 a.m. ferry or the 8:30 a.m. ferry and Ruben can still be only the 8:00 a.m. ferry, clue 4 means Gull Island cannot be the 7:30 a.m. ferry.
Gull Island must go with the 8:30 a.m. ferry: clue 4 rules out the 7:00 a.m. ferry and the 7:30 a.m. ferry; clue 1 rules out the 8:00 a.m. ferry.
Cobb Point must go with the 7:30 a.m. ferry: clue 1 rules out the 7:00 a.m. ferry and the 8:00 a.m. ferry; the 8:30 a.m. ferry already goes with Gull Island.
Priya must go with Cobb Point: Gull Island, Pine Key, and the mainland are already ruled out for the 7:30 a.m. ferry.
Tova must go with Pine Key: clue 3 rules out Gull Island and the mainland; Cobb Point already goes with Priya.
Ruben must go with the mainland: clue 4 rules out Gull Island; Cobb Point is already ruled out for the 8:00 a.m. ferry; Pine Key already goes with Tova.
Amara must go with Gull Island: the other choices are already taken.
Pine Key must go with the 7:00 a.m. ferry: clue 1 rules out the 7:30 a.m. ferry and the 8:30 a.m. ferry; the 8:00 a.m. ferry is already ruled out for Ruben.
The mainland must go with the 8:00 a.m. ferry: clue 1 rules out the 7:30 a.m. ferry and the 8:30 a.m. ferry; the 7:00 a.m. ferry already goes with Pine Key.
The 8:30 a.m. ferry goes with Gull Island, so the 8:30 a.m. ferry also goes with Amara.
Tova must go with the 7:00 a.m. ferry: clue 2 rules out the 7:30 a.m. ferry and the 8:00 a.m. ferry; the 8:30 a.m. ferry already goes with Amara.
